card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits or opening parentheses inside bracketed cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)], and sometimes a number or unit inside dose tables.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: The section number or opening parenthesis inside a [see ... (x.y)] pointer.
modes.example: suspend ezetimibe and simvastatin tablets in patients taking daptomycin [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.<<1>> )]

modes.label: Parenthesis before broken link
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a section name, followed by a hyperlink error placeholder.
modes.example: Tadalafil Tablets is not recommended [see Warnings and Precautions ( Error! Hyperlink reference not valid. )and Use in Specific Populations<< (>> Error! Hyperlink reference not valid.

modes.label: Numbers in tables
modes.description: Digits or units inside dosing tables or temperature thresholds.
